1	/** A live cell's position on an unbounded grid, as `[x, y]`. */
2	export type Cell = [x: number, y: number];
3	
4	const isSameCell = ([ax, ay]: Cell, [bx, by]: Cell): boolean =>
5	  ax === bx && ay === by;
6	
7	const ADJACENT_OFFSETS = [-1, 0, 1];
8	
9	/** The eight cells touching this one on a side or corner — itself excluded. */
10	const neighboursOf = ([x, y]: Cell): Cell[] =>
11	  ADJACENT_OFFSETS.flatMap((dx) =>
12	    ADJACENT_OFFSETS.filter((dy) => dx !== 0 || dy !== 0).map(
13	      (dy): Cell => [x + dx, y + dy],
14	    ),
15	  );
16	
17	/** Two cells touch on a side or corner when neither coordinate differs by more than 1. */
18	const areTouching = ([ax, ay]: Cell, [bx, by]: Cell): boolean =>
19	  Math.abs(ax - bx) <= 1 && Math.abs(ay - by) <= 1;
20	
21	/** Two cells are neighbours when they touch — a cell is not its own neighbour. */
22	const areNeighbours = (a: Cell, b: Cell): boolean =>
23	  areTouching(a, b) && !isSameCell(a, b);
24	
25	const countLiveNeighbours = (cell: Cell, liveCells: Cell[]): number =>
26	  liveCells.filter((candidate) => areNeighbours(candidate, cell)).length;
27	
28	/**
29	 * A live cell survives with exactly 2 or 3 live neighbours.
30	 *
31	 * This single condition covers three rules: fewer than 2 is under-population
32	 * (rule 1), 2 or 3 is survival (rule 2), more than 3 is over-population
33	 * (rule 3).
34	 */
35	const survives = (liveNeighbours: number): boolean =>
36	  liveNeighbours === 2 || liveNeighbours === 3;
37	
38	const isAlive = (cell: Cell, liveCells: Cell[]): boolean =>
39	  liveCells.some((live) => isSameCell(live, cell));
40	
41	/** A dead cell with exactly 3 live neighbours is born (rule 4, reproduction). */
42	const isBorn = (cell: Cell, liveCells: Cell[]): boolean =>
43	  !isAlive(cell, liveCells) && countLiveNeighbours(cell, liveCells) === 3;
44	
45	const withoutDuplicates = (cells: Cell[]): Cell[] =>
46	  cells.filter(
47	    (cell, index) =>
48	      cells.findIndex((other) => isSameCell(other, cell)) === index,
49	  );
50	
51	const survivorsOf = (liveCells: Cell[]): Cell[] =>
52	  liveCells.filter((cell) =>
53	    survives(countLiveNeighbours(cell, liveCells)),
54	  );
55	
56	/** Only cells adjacent to a live cell can be born, so those are the candidates. */
57	const birthsAround = (liveCells: Cell[]): Cell[] =>
58	  withoutDuplicates(
59	    liveCells.flatMap(neighboursOf).filter((cell) => isBorn(cell, liveCells)),
60	  );
61	
62	export function nextGeneration(liveCells: Cell[]): Cell[] {
63	  return [...survivorsOf(liveCells), ...birthsAround(liveCells)];
64	}
65
